results: Shared logarithmicCircleMoment uses the ORIGINAL1/(2*pi*i) logarithmic-derivative contour. A fixed boundary nonvanishing family has analytic moments in its complex Banach parameter. The weighted argument principle proves each moment equals l^k+u^k for the ACTUAL multiplicity-counted two-root cluster, including a repeated root.

Shared momentPairPolynomial reconstructs the MONIC factor z^2-m1*z+(m1^2-m2)/2 and is JOINTLY analytic in the spectral coordinate and Banach parameter. No individually analytic or ordered roots are assumed.

Shared jointCircleCauchyTransform reconstructs any analytic interior filling from its contour values and is JOINTLY analytic away from the fixed circle. The density needs analyticity only near that circle. No entire extension of the filled quotient is assumed.

The ORIGINAL native H-minus-one Hill radicand defines hillHminusGapPolynomial by its actual fixed-circle moments. EVERY valid actual high pair gives EXACT polynomial(lambda,a)=(lambda-l)*(lambda-u), with all analytic multiplicities retained. The polynomial is JOINTLY analytic on C times the original H-minus-one potential neighborhood, and is nonzero on the full contour.

hillHminusJointGapQuotient reconstructs K/polynomial from that fixed actual contour. It is JOINTLY analytic on the OPEN energy disc times the original complex H-minus-one neighborhood, and equals EVERY valid analytic two-root deflation throughout that disc, including the filled values at both actual endpoints and at collapsed gaps.

hillHminusJointNormalizedGapRoot has NO endpoint-label arguments. It is the principal root of -4*(pi*n)^2 times the intrinsic Cauchy quotient. ONE radius precedes EVERY accuracy; ONE cutoff and ONE OPEN original H-minus-one potential neighborhood precede ALL high indices, ALL nearby potentials and EVERY point of each open energy disc. The root is JOINTLY analytic, NONZERO and uniformly within epsilon of ONE.

The exact actual identity is K(lambda,a)=-hillHminusGapPolynomial(lambda,a)*S(lambda,a)^2/(4*(pi*n)^2). The SAME K retains its actual trace identity, exact radicand-zero identity, and equality with the square of the ORIGINAL shifted continued primitive wherever that continuation is admissible. Closed gaps are included. Independence of chosen endpoint labels is PROVED for the same K and contour; no global gluing across different K/contour choices is claimed.

The previous gap-root milestone proved energy analyticity with a chosen unordered pair. This continuation proves the missing JOINT potential analyticity and removes the pair from the normalized-root definition. The original Hill contour action, sheet identification, action-to-gap-square ratio, KdV Birkhoff map and actual smooth-approximation KdV flow remain UNPROVED. ALL FIVE MAIN theorems remain OPEN; goal ACTIVE.
